title: Arabic Foundations
description: Qur'anic Arabic from the ground up: how words are built, how sentences work, and about 190 of the words you will meet most. It ends with reading al-Fātiḥah word by word. To build reading speed alongside it, use [Lamha](/projects/lamha/).

units.title: How Arabic words work
units.summary: The three kinds of word, roots and patterns, and how to say "a" and "the".

units.title: Nouns
units.summary: Gender, number, and the case endings everything else depends on.

units.title: Small words that carry meaning
units.summary: Prepositions, pronouns, and the words for this, that and who.

units.title: Phrases and sentences
units.summary: Describing, possessing, and making a statement without the word "is".

units.title: Verbs
units.summary: Past, present, commands, negation, and who did what to whom.

units.title: Patterns of meaning
units.summary: The patterns that turn one root into a family of words, then a full reading.
